scope_note: This catalog is an assistant-facing guide to existing CE-RISE assets. It must not be used as a substitute for CE-RISE components, services, schemas, methods, documentation, or deployment workflows.
compliance_note: Compliance-oriented outputs are implementation planning aids, not legal certification or legal advice.
source_assumptions: The Codeberg CE-RISE repositories are the canonical software development sources.
The GitHub mirrors are used for release automation, OCI image publication, MCP registry publication, and Zenodo integration.
The assistant should guide users toward reuse and configuration of existing CE-RISE assets.

capabilities.title: CE-RISE solution discovery
capabilities.description: Identify which existing CE-RISE components, documentation, models, and deployment assets are relevant to a Digital Passport engineering goal.

capabilities.title: Digital Passport architecture guidance
capabilities.description: Recommend an implementation path that combines existing CE-RISE services, storage, models, validation, and deployment assets.

capabilities.title: Data model and semantic alignment
capabilities.description: Guide users toward existing CE-RISE and related Digital Passport model assets, then use assessment workflows to compare coverage and gaps.

capabilities.title: Implementation planning
capabilities.description: Turn a user goal into ordered engineering steps that reuse CE-RISE assets and expose assumptions, missing inputs, and validation points.

capabilities.title: Implementation readiness assessment
capabilities.description: Check whether a Digital Passport implementation has enough declared scope, data, component choices, deployment context, and validation strategy to proceed.

capabilities.title: Deployment guidance
capabilities.description: Guide users from local demonstration toward existing CE-RISE deployment assets without automating cloud deployment in the initial version.

capabilities.title: Digital Passport adoption context assessment
capabilities.description: Assess an organization's Digital Passport adoption context across scope, compliance drivers, value-chain role, data readiness, and value goals.

capabilities.title: Value-chain information mapping
capabilities.description: Map information that an organization may need to request, hold, validate, enrich, or share across Digital Passport value-chain interactions.

capabilities.title: Shared information value opportunities
capabilities.description: Identify practical value opportunities from shared Digital Passport information, including reporting efficiency, traceability, circularity services, and data quality improvements.

components.name: CE-RISE Solution Portal
components.description: Canonical human-facing entry point for the CE-RISE solution.
components.assistant_role: Use as the top-level reference when explaining how CE-RISE assets fit together.

components.name: HEX Core Service
components.description: Existing CE-RISE service asset for Digital Passport system implementations.
components.assistant_role: Guide users toward configuring and integrating the existing service rather than replacing it.

components.name: Digital Passport JSON DB Storage Service
components.description: Existing CE-RISE storage service asset for Digital Passport data.
components.assistant_role: Use when a workflow needs a CE-RISE storage component; the local demonstrator shows one example of how it can be exercised.

components.name: Digital Passport System Local Demonstrator
components.description: Existing CE-RISE local demonstration environment that illustrates one way to exercise Digital Passport system components together.
components.assistant_role: Use as a reference example for prototype learning, smoke-test design, and local validation patterns; generalize its workflow rather than treating its concrete data or local settings as defaults.

components.name: Digital Passport System GitOps Template
components.description: Existing CE-RISE deployment template for GitOps-oriented Digital Passport system deployment.
components.assistant_role: Use when guiding from local proof-of-concept toward deployment planning.

components.name: Digital Passport Model Assessment Workbench
components.description: Existing deterministic workbench and MCP server for SHACL-based Digital Passport model assessment and use-case coverage analysis.
components.assistant_role: Use for model assessment, comparison, coverage, prioritization, and composition recommendations.

components.name: CE-RISE Models
components.description: Existing CE-RISE model assets and generated artifacts.
components.assistant_role: Use as source material for data model and semantic alignment guidance.

components.name: RE Indicators Calculation Service
components.description: Existing CE-RISE service asset for resource efficiency indicator calculation workflows.
components.assistant_role: Use when a Digital Passport workflow needs CE-RISE circularity or resource-efficiency indicator calculation.

architecture_patterns.title: Local demonstrator as reference example
architecture_patterns.description: Use the existing local demonstrator to understand component behavior, integration points, and sample workflow patterns, then adapt those patterns to the adopter's own scope before deployment planning.

architecture_patterns.title: Service-backed Digital Passport system
architecture_patterns.description: Use the existing CE-RISE core and storage services as the backbone, then add validation, model assessment, and deployment planning around them.

architecture_patterns.title: Model assessment and alignment path
architecture_patterns.description: Begin with data model scope and SHACL/use-case coverage assessment before selecting the system deployment path.

architecture_patterns.title: GitOps deployment path
architecture_patterns.description: Use the existing CE-RISE GitOps template after local validation and component selection have produced a stable deployment plan.

adoption_context_fields.label: Organization role
adoption_context_fields.description: The organization's role in the value chain, such as manufacturer, supplier, recycler, service provider, integrator, marketplace, or regulator-facing operator.

adoption_context_fields.label: Passport scope
adoption_context_fields.description: The product, material, asset, process, or lifecycle slice the Digital Passport should cover.

adoption_context_fields.label: Compliance drivers
adoption_context_fields.description: The external reporting, customer, procurement, regulatory, or governance reasons for adopting a Digital Passport.

adoption_context_fields.label: Value-chain actors
adoption_context_fields.description: Upstream and downstream actors that provide, consume, validate, enrich, or rely on passport information.

adoption_context_fields.label: Shared information
adoption_context_fields.description: Information the organization expects to request, hold, validate, enrich, or share.

adoption_context_fields.label: Data sources
adoption_context_fields.description: Known data systems, files, APIs, schemas, or manual sources that can populate passport records.

adoption_context_fields.label: Existing systems
adoption_context_fields.description: Relevant internal or partner systems such as ERP, PLM, MES, LIMS, data lakes, spreadsheets, supplier portals, or APIs.

adoption_context_fields.label: Value goals
adoption_context_fields.description: Expected benefits beyond compliance, such as lower reporting effort, traceability, circularity services, supplier collaboration, or data quality improvements.

adoption_context_fields.label: Implementation constraints
adoption_context_fields.description: Time, skills, integration, data quality, governance, confidentiality, interoperability, or deployment constraints.

compliance_drivers.title: Regulatory or policy reporting
compliance_drivers.description: Structured information is needed to respond to regulatory, policy, or authority-facing reporting expectations.

compliance_drivers.title: Customer or buyer requirement
compliance_drivers.description: A downstream customer requests passport-like information, traceability evidence, product attributes, or sustainability data.

compliance_drivers.title: Sustainability and circularity claims
compliance_drivers.description: Passport information is needed to support sustainability, circularity, repair, reuse, recycling, or resource-efficiency claims.

compliance_drivers.title: Supply-chain traceability
compliance_drivers.description: The organization needs a clearer chain of custody, provenance, lifecycle events, or actor accountability across the value chain.

compliance_drivers.title: Internal data governance and reuse
compliance_drivers.description: The Digital Passport effort is also a way to improve internal data quality, interoperability, and reuse across teams or systems.

value_chain_flow_types.title: Product identity and classification
value_chain_flow_types.description: Identifiers, versioning, classification, and basic passport metadata used to connect records across systems and actors.

value_chain_flow_types.title: Material and composition information
value_chain_flow_types.description: Information about materials, components, composition, substances, or bill-of-material structures.

value_chain_flow_types.title: Provenance and lifecycle events
value_chain_flow_types.description: Actor, location, event, transformation, use, repair, reuse, and end-of-life signals that create traceability.

value_chain_flow_types.title: Compliance evidence and declarations
value_chain_flow_types.description: Declarations, certificates, checks, assertions, or evidence records needed for reporting and due-diligence workflows.

value_chain_flow_types.title: Circularity and resource-efficiency indicators
value_chain_flow_types.description: Information used to calculate, explain, or compare circularity and resource-efficiency indicators.

value_chain_flow_types.title: Service, repair, reuse, and end-of-life information
value_chain_flow_types.description: Information that supports maintenance, repair, second-life decisions, recycling, reverse logistics, and end-of-life handling.

value_opportunity_patterns.title: Reduce repeated reporting effort
value_opportunity_patterns.description: Reuse structured passport information to reduce manual reporting and repeated customer or authority-facing data preparation.

value_opportunity_patterns.title: Improve supplier-customer information exchange
value_opportunity_patterns.description: Use passport structures to make requested and shared information more explicit, reusable, and easier to validate.

value_opportunity_patterns.title: Strengthen traceability confidence
value_opportunity_patterns.description: Connect actor, provenance, lifecycle, and evidence records so downstream users can understand where information comes from.

value_opportunity_patterns.title: Enable circularity services
value_opportunity_patterns.description: Use shared information to support repair, reuse, second-life, recycling, and resource-efficiency workflows.

value_opportunity_patterns.title: Improve internal data quality and interoperability
value_opportunity_patterns.description: Use passport adoption to clarify source systems, ownership, joins, identifiers, and validation rules across internal workflows.

adoption_paths.title: Exploration and readiness path
adoption_paths.description: Clarify scope, drivers, actors, information needs, and available data before selecting implementation components.

adoption_paths.title: Local prototype path
adoption_paths.description: Move from adoption context into a generalized local workflow using the CE-RISE local demonstrator as an example of service interaction and sample information-flow checks.

adoption_paths.title: Model-first alignment path
adoption_paths.description: Start from schemas, SHACL assets, and use-case coverage before selecting the final service or deployment path.

adoption_paths.title: Value-chain exchange path
adoption_paths.description: Focus first on requested and shared information between actors, then map the exchange to CE-RISE model and service assets.

adoption_paths.title: Deployment preparation path
adoption_paths.description: Use after a local prototype or model assessment has produced stable component choices and deployment constraints.

readiness_fields.label: Passport scope
readiness_fields.description: The product, material, asset, or process scope of the Digital Passport.

readiness_fields.label: User goal
readiness_fields.description: The concrete engineering goal the passport system should support.

readiness_fields.label: Data sources
readiness_fields.description: Known data systems, files, APIs, schemas, or manual sources that can populate passport records.

readiness_fields.label: Selected CE-RISE components
readiness_fields.description: Existing CE-RISE assets selected for reuse.

readiness_fields.label: Data model strategy
readiness_fields.description: Declared schema, SHACL, semantic model, or assessment path.

readiness_fields.label: Deployment context
readiness_fields.description: Reference-example learning, local container workflow, GitOps, Kubernetes, or other target context.

readiness_fields.label: Validation strategy
readiness_fields.description: Planned checks for model coverage, data quality, integration readiness, and deployment smoke tests.
